Current Account Deficit – Kenya
The current account deficit is expected to narrow to 5.4% of GDP in 2018 largely due to;
• Lower imports of food
• Lower imports in the second phase of the SGR project
• Steady growth in tea and horticulture exports
• Strong diaspora remittances
• continued growth in receipts from tourism.
